references.publication_status: Published journal article; consulted author accepted-manuscript preprint

version_consulted.version_note: arXiv labels RA-L 2024; Crossref assigns the journal issue to February 2025. Cite 2025 for volume 10(2), 1241–1248; 2024 for this preprint version.

attributions.location: III-B, Eq. (1); III-C–D, Eqs. (3)–(8); VI-B, Eq. (9); VI-C
attributions.finding: Merged mean axial profile, hover-velocity and motor-distance normalization, fitted decay/spread/origin parameters.

attributions.location: Fig. 2; IV-B, Table I; IV-C; V; VII-A, Eqs. (10)–(11)
attributions.finding: Opposite-motor scale; hover/near-hover measurements; uncanted fit; far-field boundary; maintained-thrust ideal power compensation.

assumptions_and_limits: Mean far field of predominantly hovering vehicles; does not establish swarm superposition or the repository receiver law.
Table I spans 230 g–6.3 kg; the 27 g repository vehicle is outside that measured mass range.
Rotated tilted wakes, finite support, four point receiver samples and fixed-power thrust conversion are repository adaptations, not validations from this paper.

attributions.finding: Propeller-specific measured inflow/thrust response feeds summed forces and moments; validation includes substantial close-separation mismatch.

assumptions_and_limits: Two vehicle types with fitted parameters, not a universal receiver conversion.
The response uses an experimentally fitted inflow and rotor-speed law; it is not the repository cubic.
IV-G reports disagreement at 0.5 m; matching larger separations cannot validate repository near-wake exclusion or its smaller vehicle.

references.title: Influence of Static and Dynamic Downwash Interactions on Multi-Quadrotor Systems
references.publication_status: Published RSS XXI proceedings paper; consulted arXiv v1 full text

version_consulted.version_note: RSS proceedings title/authors/year/DOI verified. Full text consulted is arXiv v1; publisher PDF byte-equivalence not established.

attributions.finding: Crazyflie load-cell measurements with 4 V/PWM operation; l = 32.5 mm has ambiguous prose. Figures and cross-paper conversion support projected half-side. See normalization correction.

attributions.location: III-B2, Eqs. (3)–(6), Table I; III-B3, Figs. 12–13; III-C, Figs. 15–16; V
attributions.finding: Measured jet scaling, interacting-pair flow changes and approach/retreat-dependent forces/moments; homogeneous, traverse-limited experiments.

assumptions_and_limits: Constant voltage is not constant rotor frequency or the repository constant induced-power assumption.
Length mapping must distinguish radial arm and projected half-side. Supported projected reading gives opposite-motor D = 2√2 l. The previous asserted radial-arm mapping is superseded.
III-A and IV use inconsistent percentage wording for thrust loss; no quantitative loss target is adopted here.
Related dataset DOI 10.26300/64d4-wa17 could not be accessed through the web tool; raw observations were not acquired or compared.
